cohort: 311 postpartum patients who underwent elective cesarean delivery between 34 and 41 weeks of gestation, excluding those with vaginal delivery, multiple pregnancies, stillbirths, fetal abnormalities, maternal cardiac disease, anemia, untreated hypo- or hyperthyroidism, or hypertensive disorders.
finding: The mean Shock Index (SI) value was approximately 0.7 (0.67-0.77) within the first 48 hours postpartum, with the 90th and 95th percentiles of SI being around 0.9.
mod_finding: Shock Index values were not influenced by the presence of a previous caesarean section.
